CREATE FUNCTION CDN.SlownieSegmentPL(@p_Num integer,@p_part varchar(10)) RETURNS VARCHAR(50) AS BEGIN IF @p_Num=0 Return '' If @p_Num=1 Return 'jeden ' + @p_part IF @p_Num>999 Return 'Błędna liczba (>999)'
DECLARE @set INTEGER, @dzi INTEGER, @jed INTEGER DECLARE @segment VARCHAR(255) SET @segment = ''
SET @set = (@p_Num/100) SET @dzi = (@p_Num - 100*@set)/10 SET @jed = (@p_Num - 100*@set - 10*@dzi)
SET @segment = CASE @set WHEN 9 THEN 'dziewięćset ' WHEN 8 THEN 'osiemset ' WHEN 7 THEN 'siedemset ' WHEN 6 THEN 'sześćset ' WHEN 5 THEN 'pięćset ' WHEN 4 THEN 'czterysta ' WHEN 3 THEN 'trzysta ' WHEN 2 THEN 'dwieście ' WHEN 1 THEN 'sto ' ELSE '' END
SET @segment = @segment + CASE @dzi WHEN 9 THEN 'dziewięćdziesiąt ' WHEN 8 THEN 'osiemdziesiąt ' WHEN 7 THEN 'siedemdziesiąt ' WHEN 6 THEN 'sześćdziesiąt ' WHEN 5 THEN 'pięćdziesiąt ' WHEN 4 THEN 'czterdzieści ' WHEN 3 THEN 'trzydzieści ' WHEN 2 THEN 'dwadzieścia ' WHEN 1 THEN CASE @jed WHEN 9 THEN 'dziewiętnaście ' WHEN 8 THEN 'osiemnaście ' WHEN 7 THEN 'siedemnaście ' WHEN 6 THEN 'szesnaście ' WHEN 5 THEN 'piętnaście ' WHEN 4 THEN 'czternaście ' WHEN 3 THEN 'trzynaście ' WHEN 2 THEN 'dwanaście ' WHEN 1 THEN 'jedenaście ' WHEN 0 THEN 'dziesięć ' END ELSE '' END
If @dzi <> 1 BEGIN SET @segment = @segment + CASE @jed WHEN 9 THEN 'dziewięć ' WHEN 8 THEN 'osiem ' WHEN 7 THEN 'siedem ' WHEN 6 THEN 'sześć ' WHEN 5 THEN 'pięć ' WHEN 4 THEN 'cztery ' WHEN 3 THEN 'trzy ' WHEN 2 THEN 'dwa ' WHEN 1 THEN 'jeden ' ELSE '' END END
RETURN (@segment + @p_part) END

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.SlownieSegmentEN(@p_Num integer,@p_part varchar(10)) RETURNS VARCHAR(50) AS BEGIN IF @p_Num=0 Return '' If @p_Num=1 Return 'one ' + @p_part IF @p_Num>999 Return 'Wrong number (>999)'
DECLARE @set INTEGER, @dzi INTEGER, @jed INTEGER DECLARE @segment VARCHAR(255) SET @segment = ''
SET @set = (@p_Num/100) SET @dzi = (@p_Num - 100*@set)/10 SET @jed = (@p_Num - 100*@set - 10*@dzi)
SET @segment = CASE @set WHEN 9 THEN 'nine hundred ' WHEN 8 THEN 'eight hundred ' WHEN 7 THEN 'seven hundred ' WHEN 6 THEN 'six hundred ' WHEN 5 THEN 'five hundred ' WHEN 4 THEN 'four hundred ' WHEN 3 THEN 'three hundred ' WHEN 2 THEN 'two hundred ' WHEN 1 THEN 'one hundred ' ELSE '' END
SET @segment = @segment + CASE @dzi WHEN 9 THEN 'ninety ' WHEN 8 THEN 'eighty ' WHEN 7 THEN 'seventy ' WHEN 6 THEN 'sixty ' WHEN 5 THEN 'fifty ' WHEN 4 THEN 'forty ' WHEN 3 THEN 'thirty ' WHEN 2 THEN 'twenty ' WHEN 1 THEN CASE @jed WHEN 9 THEN 'nineteen ' WHEN 8 THEN 'eighteen ' WHEN 7 THEN 'seventeen ' WHEN 6 THEN 'sixteen ' WHEN 5 THEN 'fifteen ' WHEN 4 THEN 'fourteen ' WHEN 3 THEN 'thirteen ' WHEN 2 THEN 'twelve ' WHEN 1 THEN 'eleven ' WHEN 0 THEN 'ten ' END ELSE '' END
If @dzi <> 1 BEGIN SET @segment = @segment + CASE @jed WHEN 9 THEN 'nine ' WHEN 8 THEN 'eight ' WHEN 7 THEN 'seven ' WHEN 6 THEN 'six ' WHEN 5 THEN 'five ' WHEN 4 THEN 'four ' WHEN 3 THEN 'three ' WHEN 2 THEN 'two ' WHEN 1 THEN 'one ' ELSE '' END END
RETURN (@segment + @p_part) END

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.SlownieSegmentDE(@p_Num integer,@p_part varchar(10)) RETURNS VARCHAR(50) AS BEGIN IF @p_Num=0 Return ''
If @p_Num=1 if @p_part = 'Million' Return 'eine' + ' ' + @p_part+ ' '
if @p_Num=1 Return 'ein' + @p_part IF @p_Num>999 Return 'Falsche Zahl (>999)' DECLARE @set INTEGER, @dzi INTEGER, @jed INTEGER DECLARE @segment VARCHAR(255) DECLARE @segment_2 VARCHAR(255)
SET @segment = '' SET @segment_2 = ''
SET @set = (@p_Num/100) SET @dzi = (@p_Num - 100*@set)/10 SET @jed = (@p_Num - 100*@set - 10*@dzi)
if @p_part = 'Milliarde' if @p_num > 1 SET @p_part =' Milliarden ' if @p_part = 'Million' if @p_num > 1 SET @p_part =' Millionen '
SET @segment = CASE @dzi WHEN 9 THEN 'neunzig' WHEN 8 THEN 'achtzig' WHEN 7 THEN 'siebzig' WHEN 6 THEN 'sechzig' WHEN 5 THEN 'fünfzig' WHEN 4 THEN 'vierzig' WHEN 3 THEN 'dreißig' WHEN 2 THEN 'zwanzig' WHEN 1 THEN
CASE @jed WHEN 9 THEN 'neunzehn' WHEN 8 THEN 'achtzehn' WHEN 7 THEN 'siebzehn' WHEN 6 THEN 'sechzehn' WHEN 5 THEN 'fünfzehn' WHEN 4 THEN 'vierzehn' WHEN 3 THEN 'dreizehn' WHEN 2 THEN 'zwölf' WHEN 1 THEN 'elf' WHEN 0 THEN 'zehn' END ELSE '' END
If @dzi <> 1 BEGIN SET @segment_2 = CASE @jed
WHEN 9 THEN 'neun' WHEN 8 THEN 'acht' WHEN 7 THEN 'sieben' WHEN 6 THEN 'sechs' WHEN 5 THEN 'fünf' WHEN 4 THEN 'vier' WHEN 3 THEN 'drei' WHEN 2 THEN 'zwei' WHEN 1 THEN 'ein' ELSE '' END
if @jed <> 0 if @dzi<>0 SET @segment = @segment_2 + 'und' + @segment if @dzi < 1 SET @segment = @segment + @segment_2
END
SET @segment = CASE @set WHEN 9 THEN 'neunhundert' WHEN 8 THEN 'achthundert' WHEN 7 THEN 'siebenhundert' WHEN 6 THEN 'sechshundert' WHEN 5 THEN 'fünfhundert' WHEN 4 THEN 'vierhundert' WHEN 3 THEN 'dreihundert' WHEN 2 THEN 'zweihundert' WHEN 1 THEN 'einhundert' ELSE '' END + @segment
RETURN (@segment + @p_part) END

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.Slownie(@p_Num decimal(15,2),@p_Currency varchar(3), @p_Lang varchar(2)) RETURNS VARCHAR(255) AS BEGIN DECLARE @mld BIGINT DECLARE @mln BIGINT DECLARE @tys BIGINT DECLARE @jed BIGINT DECLARE @gr BIGINT
declare @Smld varchar(30) declare @Smln varchar(30) declare @Stys varchar(30)
IF ISNULL(@p_Currency,'')='' SELECT @p_Currency=ISNULL(Kon_Wartosc,'PLN') FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer=211
SET @p_Num=Abs(@p_Num)
SET @mld = (@p_Num/1000000000) SET @mln = (@p_Num - 1000000000*@mld)/1000000 SET @tys = ((@p_Num - 1000000000*@mld - 1000000*@mln)/1000) SET @jed = (@p_Num - 1000000000*@mld - 1000000*@mln - 1000*@tys) SET @gr = (100*(@p_Num - 1000000000*@mld - 1000000*@mln - 1000*@tys - @jed))
if(@mld=1) set @Smld = 'miliard ' else if(@mld <20 and @mld >4) set @Smld = 'miliardów ' else if(@mld <5) set @Smld = 'miliardy ' else if(@mld % 10 in (1,5,6,7,8,9,0)) set @Smld = 'miliardów ' else set @Smld = 'miliardy '
if(@mln=1) set @Smln = 'milion ' else if(@mln <20 and @mln >4) set @Smln = 'milionów ' else if(@mln <5) set @Smln = 'miliony ' else if(@mln % 10 in (1,5,6,7,8,9,0)) set @Smln = 'milionów ' else set @Smln = 'miliony '
if(@tys=1) set @Stys = 'tysiąc ' else if(@tys <20 and @tys >4) set @Stys = 'tysięcy ' else if(@tys <5) set @Stys = 'tysiące ' else if(@tys % 10 in (1,5,6,7,8,9,0)) set @Stys = 'tysięcy ' else set @Stys = 'tysiące '
RETURN CASE @p_Lang WHEN 'EN' Then CDN.SlownieSegmentEN(@mld, 'Billion ') + CDN.SlownieSegmentEN(@mln, 'Million ') + CDN.SlownieSegmentEN(@tys, 'thousand ') + case when @jed>0 AND @tys+@mln>0 then 'and ' else '' end + CDN.SlownieSegmentEN(@jed, '') WHEN 'DE' THEN CDN.SlownieSegmentDE(@mld, 'Milliarde') + CDN.SlownieSegmentDE(@mln, 'Million') + CDN.SlownieSegmentDE(@tys,'tausend') + CDN.SlownieSegmentDE(@jed,'') ELSE CDN.SlownieSegmentPL(@mld, @Smld) + CDN.SlownieSegmentPL(@mln, @Smln) + CDN.SlownieSegmentPL(@tys, @Stys) + CDN.SlownieSegmentPL(@jed, '') END + @p_Currency +' '+REPLACE(SPACE(2-LEN(cast(@gr As Varchar(2)))),' ','0') +cast(@gr As Varchar)+'/100' END
